the choice of the antibiotic regimen in cesarean section is a complex problem, which must be considered from the clinical and economical points of view.

the choice of AP in cesarean section is a cost-effective procedure, provided that the selective criteria are strictly followed.

the use of AP is cost-effective only in cesarean section in the high risk group, while in the low risk group AP should be used only if its cost is less than L. 10,095.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the choice of the most suitable antibiotic treatment should be made on a selective basis, according to the patient's risk of infection, and should be based on an accurate cost-effectiveness evaluation of the different therapeutic options.
